name: mail-client-cert-expires-tomorrow
description: The client certificate that the user's production presents to a partner expires tomorrow at noon: only the user can install the new one and the deadline is close, so the user is told now.
recordedBy: written for the held-out set before any run (Story 0.26)

item.subject: Your client certificate for our results service expires tomorrow
item.text: Hello, the client certificate your production uses to connect to our results service expires tomorrow at 12:00 UTC. A new certificate is ready for you in our partner portal. Install it before then, or we will refuse your connections. Thanks, Results Partner IT
